comparison.objective: Seat a heatsink vertically without smearing thermal paste, unlike iterative damper tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part alignment and straight-down insertion with lateral-motion control; no unlocking, fine rotation, counterhold, or dynamic-response judgment.
comparison.success_condition: Heatsink must be seated without sliding across paste; the record supplies no numeric seating, slide, force, paste, or damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained planar alignment and insertion, not retained adjustment or repeated impact validation.
